reported.label: Q4 order inflow Rs 898 billion
reported.quote: Order inflows in Q4 FY26 stood at Rs 898 billion, broadly in line with Q4 FY25 levels

reported.label: Order book Rs 7.40 trillion, up 28%
reported.quote: our order book stands at Rs 7.40 trillion as of March 2026, a 28% YoY increase

reported.quote: our group revenues for Q4 FY26 was Rs 828 billion and registered a YoY growth of 11%

reported.quote: our group-level EBITDA margin, excluding other income, for Q4 FY '26 is 10.4% as compared to 11%

reported.label: FY26 revenue growth 12%
reported.quote: On the revenue front, growth for FY26 stood at 12% compared to our guidance of 15%
